description: The next occurrence strictly after the base date (default today) of either a tracked event slug (e.g. "christmas") or a weekday (0 = Sunday .. 6 = Saturday). Provide exactly one of event/weekday.

event.description: Event slug (e.g. christmas). Exactly one of event/weekday.

from.description: ISO date YYYY-MM-DD, or "today" (resolved in tz)

tz.description: IANA timezone that defines "today" (e.g. Africa/Kampala). Default UTC.

weekday.description: 0 = Sunday .. 6 = Saturday. Exactly one of event/weekday.

name: next_occurrence

receipt.description: Auditable receipt: inputs, timezone, convention, workweek, holiday calendar, exclusions, versions, stable result ID

title: Next occurrence of an event or weekday
